[@sakaladev/usai](/docs/sdk/) / [index](/docs/sdk/index/) / describe



```ts
function describe(app: AppDeclaration): Manifest;
```

Turn an [AppDeclaration](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/appdeclaration/) into its [Manifest](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/manifest/). The build
phase calls it inside a capability-less world; call it yourself to
assert on an application's shape in a unit test. Throws on a duplicate
workload, a conflicting resource redeclaration, or a hole in a list.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `app` | [`AppDeclaration`](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/appdeclaration/) |

## Returns

[`Manifest`](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/manifest/)
